title: Aeropus the conspirator
summary: Raleigh names Aeropus the conspirator in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aeropus, whose treason at Halicarnassus a Swallow is said to haue foreshewen, hired by Darius to slay Alexander. He is not Aeropus the Macedonian King. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
